title: architecture-capabilities-view
description: The READ-ONLY Control Center projection of the ADR-0017 layered reference architecture (docs/architecture.md §16.2.1, §18) for the AWCMS Architecture view (issue #246, part 3). It carries planes as lanes and capabilities as cards - only closed enums, bounded identifiers, and a provenance/version stamp, sourced from architecture/capabilities.json (schema 1.1.0) and the plane table in docs/architecture.md §18.3. This is a PROJECTION for display only: it is never itself an authorization mechanism, carries no ADR text, evidence URLs, removal triggers, or module implementation paths beyond the bounded `omes_module` identifier, and MUST NEVER carry a raw shell/command escape hatch - additionalProperties=false at every object level makes this structural, not merely a convention (registry guard C1 in lib/omes/py/architecture/registry.py additionally forbids any property key named/containing command, cmd, shell, script, exec, or argv anywhere under contracts/control-center/v1/*.schema.json). Server-side authorization (who may read this projection) is enforced by AWCMS before this shape is produced; this schema describes the wire shape only.

schema_version.description: This view contract's own version (independent of the architecture/capabilities.json registry's schema_version 1.1.0).

omes_version.description: The OMES release (VERSION file) the projection was generated from.

omes_commit.description: The OMES git commit the projection was generated from, or 'unknown' when no git checkout is available.

planes.description: The six reference-architecture planes (docs/architecture.md §18.3), rendered as lanes.

capabilities.description: One card per architecture/capabilities.json entry, projected down to the fields a plane lane needs to render.

upstream_project.description: The upstream project this capability is delegated/ported/adapted from, or null when OMES/AWCMS itself is the owner.

omes_module.description: The lib/omes/py submodule that implements this capability, or null when none exists (delegated, staged, or a logical boundary).
